limits: Three sparse clouds of seven natural dark ochre/black hornets, independent wing angles, no fire/glowing ball. Source species/fine leg count unavailable in low resolution and conservatively interpreted.
Each prop rect encloses a multi-component native insect cloud; renderer must preserve aspect ratio. Suggested48px width is authored readability scale only, projectile collision remains separate.
Native hidden RGB/fringe pixels retained; alpha>=8+4px crop is metadata only, never source editing. First-phase swarm art excludes phase-two Bullet Bee mouth rays.
